notes.title: First update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for the warm welcome!
We are very glad that you are playing and write reviews.
We have prepared a small update, where we fixed minor bugs and edited the text.
I hope now it will be even more pleasant to play!
We also collected all the music tracks into one album, and you can find it on steam too!
Do not hesitate to email us about the errors found, and then we can fix them!
Nice game, and not to be forgotten!
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37544146/44480e4a4d7ebcf6e803f48d02ed8aace03fd0af.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Unforgotten Has Launched!!!!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited moment has come! a year of work, dozens of script options, art that was redrawn many times, a painful choice of music, bug fixes, participation in festivals and competitions – all this was not in vain! Today our game is available for purchase. 

We look forward to your feedback and impressions. We hope that you will also be fascinated by the mysterious atmosphere of the northern mining village. The most important thing is to try to survive! And, of course, have fun. 

Have a nice game, the development team of Scoreboard. team.

notes.title: Solve the riddle of the Unforgotten
notes.notes:
Let's play a demo and solve the riddles of an abandoned village.
We will try not to freeze in the forest and not get drunk on the holiday!

notes.title: Unforgotten Demo - Steam Game Festival
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

The Unforgotten team invites you to join us at the 2020 Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition!

We`ve been working hard to present a new demo version of our game during the festival!

For those who are not yet familiar with our project, the festival provides a great opportunity to play Unforgotten! We also look forward to all those who have already played our first demo version. It was your comments and feedback that helped us make the game even better! An exciting story, many secrets and a mystical atmosphere of the Northern ethnic group are waiting for you in an abandoned village.

We are waiting for everyone at the 2020 Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition! We will be very grateful for your support and adding our game to your wishlists! We also will be happy to get your feedback, because you are the one who helps us become better!

Follow our official pages on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294310/Unforgotten]Steam[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Unforgotten_sb]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://vk.com/unforgotten_vn]VK [/url]to get the news from the development fields!
